lastCommit.message:
[ota-hal] OTA-1676: the tail is read (slice 4c)

Item three of "fix all existing issues one through six": #98, the last unit of
slice 4 — the exotic reword pass, the shield DR/reflect riders, and the
Shield-Hammer's timed +2 AC. Slice 4 is closed with this.

THE MEASUREMENT FIRST
Slice 4's probe, re-run on the current catalog: 316 effect strings, 200 parsed,
116 unread. Twenty-nine of the unread were rows of app/data/items/runecasters.json
— a catalog nothing in the app imports (the suite asserts it) — so the live tail
was 87, the "~85" the task recorded. It is 28 now, and every one of the 28 is on
a flavour list BY NAME: HP grants that `statBonuses` already pays, faction-issue
lines, the bucklers' bash (paid by the shield tag), and six sentences this OTA
wrote to say plainly that a weapon does nothing special. A card that promises
something unread cannot be authored again without failing the suite.

THE SHIELD RIDERS — what OTA-1645 admitted it only half read
Nine shields print a soak ("reduces incoming slashing by 1d6", "blocks +1d6 from
physical attacks", Graviton's "+1d6 environmental damage reduction"), an
immunity ("Blocks all plasma damage", "Blocks Aetheric-based damage", "Deflects
runecasters") or a bite ("Deals 1d6 damage on the block", "reflects 1d6 back").
All three are spent ONLY on a blow that landed on the shield — OTA-1646's
landing roll is what makes that honest; a plate that turns slashing does nothing
for a blow that came around it to your ribs. The soak runs as a pool after the
mitigation floor (OTA-924's own carve-out for the ward). The bite goes through
OTA-1671's reflect path, lifted into one helper (`dealReflectToAttacker`) so the
raised-BLOCK path pays it too — owed by the block, not by the wound, so a spiked
shield that soaked the whole blow still bites. A kill by reflect is a defeat.
"Plasma" reads as burn: every plasma weapon is typed burn and no enemy deals a
type called plasma, so a plasma shield turns burn or turns nothing. The two "on
max roll" bites became "on the block" — a shield has no roll to be max on.
⚠ A tagged buckler with nothing on its card is a held shield now: the Mud and
Iron Bucklers parsed to nothing, so no blow ever landed on them and they never
wore. The tag is what makes a shield a shield.

THE WIELDER'S OWN SHARE, on machinery that already existed
guard (a timed +N AC — the Shield-Hammer's "+2 AC for 1 round after a hit",
read by statusAcAdjustment through one new kind, `guard_up`, combat-only like a
stance), cover (`in_cover`), ward (OTA-835's `stone_ward` soak pool, rolled once
when raised, replaces the old one) and heal (clamped to the room there is).
Thirteen cards were reworded onto ONE grammar for the four, because a parser
loose enough to read "Shields caster with mud barrier; blocks 1d6 damage. 3
rounds." would read a shield's "blocks +1d6 from physical attacks" as a ward.
"On use" pays on the swing (a ward you raise lands on a miss too); "after a hit"
pays on the hit.

THE CATALOG'S OWN WORDS, READ
"pins enemies" (restrained), "reduces enemy speed" (slowed), "pushes the target
back" / "pushed back" (knockback — the War Pike's "Strength save or" is a 50%
gate), "disables Tartarian tech" (stunned, machines only), "+1 damage to tech"
(mechanical), "the arc jumps to one extra enemy" (a blast with a headcount), and
a new `pull` control — the mirror of knockback, dragged in off its footing, a
hinder that never braces, the magnets restricted to metal. The on-hit shred
OTA-1563 left "for the shred slice" ("reduces enemy armor by N on hit") lands on
the same enemyArmorShred lever, capped like the acid coating's.

THE REWORDS, 52 cards, onto mechanics of the same weight or onto honest flavour:
the "decay keeps going" lines into real festering riders (OTA-1643's DOT shape);
"instantly kills … if HP below 20" into +20 on a max roll; "50% enemy HP loss on
20+" into +2d10 on a max roll; "ignores shields on advantage rolls" into a max
roll; "auto-wins vs Aetherkin" into +1d6 against them; the summons and the
collapse into blasts; the teleport into a guard after a hit; the resurrection
into a heal after a hit; the parry-break blade into a max-roll burst. Bone Shiv
said "+1 to Stealth" over a `statBonuses` row of +2 — it says +2 now. The
impossible ones with nothing of equal weight (repair, coercion, grip, parry,
rust) say so in plain words.

gameStore absorbed the family under its OTA-1400 ratchet by giving up two set()
blocks (the max-roll shred and the control landing) to
app/state/weaponRiderEffects.ts.

- app/engine/weaponEffects.ts — ShieldAc.dr/immune/reflect + shieldRidersFrom;
  SelfBuff + selfBuffFrom; onHitShred; `pull`; the widened control, target and
  blast vocabularies; shieldDamageReduction, rollShieldReflect.
- app/engine/enemyControl.ts — pull: −2, "dragged in".
- app/engine/types.ts — `guard_up`, StatusEffect.acBonus.
- app/engine/statusEffects.ts — guard_up in statusAcAdjustment and the
  combat-only set; applyEffect keeps the larger acBonus.
- app/engine/equipment.ts — heldShieldAc returns the riders; tagged shields
  count.
- app/state/combatResolution.ts — the riders after the landing roll; the bite
  on the block and on a raised BLOCK; dealReflectToAttacker.
- app/state/weaponRiderEffects.ts — new: planSelfBuff / applyWeaponSelfBuff,
  shredEnemyArmor, landControlOnScene.
- app/state/gameStore.ts — the "use" and "hit" shares wired, on-hit shred,
  splash headcount; two blocks moved out.
- app/data/items/weapons.json — 52 effect lines.
- __tests__/ota1676TheTailIsRead.test.ts — 60 tests: the tail ratchet by name,
  the runecasters.json orphan check, every rider and buff off the real rows,
  the pure planners, the status, the wiring.
- ota1643 / ota1645 / ota1564 / ota1565 / ota1671 — pins repointed with the
  reason: three debts paid, four timed ACs read elsewhere, the Deathblade
  paid, six more blasts, the reflect helper.
